messages:
Auditor_Elena: Hi team — requesting an evidence provenance pack for INC-2024-09-10. We need RBAC grant deltas, STS AssumeRole chains, KMS Decrypt/GenerateDataKey events, approver proof, exact queries/commands used, per-artifact SHA256s, and a 1-2 sentence control mapping to SOC2 CC6/CC7 and ISO A.9/A.12. Also want chain-of-custody statements.

devsec_mai: Acknowledged. We'll produce an isolated export (no unrelated data) and include a signed manifest. Which KMS key ID is in scope?

Auditor_Elena: Key: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789:key/qw12-er34. Map primarily to SOC2 CC6 (access controls) and ISO 27001 A.9.2 / A.12.4 (logging & crypto ops).

ryan-oncall: Elevation was via runbook-service v5 during triage ticket TR-9001 after product-security approved. TTL was 15 minutes. I'll snapshot the runbook transaction and include the PR/approval link and ticket.

chris-sre: KMS events are in CloudTrail forwarded to our ELK cluster. I'll pull Decrypt and GenerateDataKey events for the key and cross-reference CloudTrail eventIDs with STS AssumeRole eventIDs. Note: runbook-service creates ephemeral sessions so you'll see sts:AssumeRole -> Decrypt under same session id.

devsec_mai: DB export plan: extract role_bindings entries where ticket='TR-9001' and the audit_log entries showing grant pre/post states. Command used: ```PGHOST=auth-db psql -c "COPY (SELECT id,user,role,created_at,context FROM role_bindings WHERE ticket='TR-9001') TO STDOUT WITH CSV" > rbac_TR9001.csv```

chris-sre: ELK query I ran: ```POST /_search
{ "query": { "bool": { "must": [ { "match": { "eventName": "Decrypt" } }, { "match": { "resources": "qw12-er34" } }, { "range": { "@timestamp": { "gte": "2024-09-10T15:30:00Z","lte":"2024-09-10T16:30:00Z" } } } ] } } }``` Returned 3 Decrypt events and 1 GenerateDataKey in window.

ryan-oncall: Uploaded RBAC snapshot to internal store: https://internal.redwood/snapshots/TR-9001/rbac-export-6367890155.csv (auditor-only).

exportd-bot: Evidence bundle created: s3://redwood-audit-exports/TR-9001/evidence-6367890178.tar.gz (expires 7d). Manifest URL: https://internal.redwood/manifest/6367890178. Bundle SHA256 (overall): e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855.

Auditor_Elena: Please ensure manifest has these fields: artifact_name, sha256, created_by, approver, control_map (comma-separated), event_ids (RBAC, STS, KMS), reproduction_queries (exact commands), chain_of_custody (exporter, checksum_actor, storage_location), and a short note explaining any multi-principal appearances.

devsec_mai: Will include those. Chain-of-custody: exported by ryan-oncall, checksum computed by exportd-bot, uploaded to S3 with auditors@redwood ACL. We'll include HMAC-signed manifest entry and per-artifact SHA256s. IPs will be redacted.

chris-sre: Small note: a telemetry helper pod also issued a Decrypt while collecting certs; we correlated via sessionToken and annotated the manifest to avoid confusion about multiple principals.

Auditor_Elena: Good. Also include the exact AWS CloudTrail lookup and the cloud DB dump command strings in the manifest so we can reproduce. And attach a 1-paragraph narrative tying the RBAC delta to the triage decision and fallback planning if KMS had been unavailable.

ryan-oncall: Draft narrative: "During INC-2024-09-10 the runbook required temporary elevated write access to rotate a compromised token. Product-security approved TR-9001 with a 15-minute TTL grant. KMS Decrypt events show the runbook retrieved secret material; fallback was a documented manual rotation procedure and escalation to on-call if KMS was unavailable."

devsec_mai: Manifest snippet (uploaded as plain text entry): artifact_name: evidence-6367890178.tar.gz; sha256: e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855; created_by: ryan-oncall; approver: prod-sec; control_map: SOC2-CC6,SOC2-CC7,ISO-A.9,ISO-A.12; notes: IPs redacted; sessionToken correlation added; HMAC-signed. Full manifest at manifest URL.

exportd-bot: Auditor access granted to auditors@redwood for 168 hours. Pre-signed link sent to Auditor_Elena.

Auditor_Elena: Received bundle and manifest. Two final asks: 1) include the raw eventIDs for STS and KMS so we can verify chaining, 2) include the exact ELK/CloudTrail and psql commands in the manifest.

chris-sre: STS eventIDs: sts-evt-zz1a2b, sts-evt-yy3c4d. KMS eventIDs: kms-evt-x9w8v7, kms-evt-p6o5n4. RBAC export event id: rbac-evt-snap6367890155. All added to manifest along with reproduction queries.

devsec_mai: Uploaded final artifacts and the signed manifest. Closing evidence task SEC-1600 and adding a pointer to the ISO control pack.

Auditor_Elena: This is exactly what we needed. I'll mark SEC-1600 as Accepted in the audit tracker unless I surface anything else during review. Thanks and :thumbsup:.
